speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. My wife is concerned about your bizarre and agitated behavior; can you tell me exactly what happened and how you have been feeling lately?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia, first episode.

The clinical presentation of a 6-week history of persecutory delusions (NSA surveillance), second-hand auditory hallucinations (mind control), social withdrawal, and functional decline (job termination) strongly supports this diagnosis. Have you or anyone else noticed any changes in your sleep pattern or appetite recently?
